title: The Oversold Event
description: Concurrent seat holds oversell events, mobile retries duplicate bookings, and expiry workers release inventory twice.
objective: Reproduce the reported failures and repair the implementation without changing its public interfaces.
expectedBehavior: The C++ port uses the provided read-only transactional Database simulator, not SQLite. Database.transaction serializes access, commits on success and rolls back on exceptions. Use its State exclusively inside transactions; do not add your own locks or alter support.hpp. Reservation fields mirror the Python rows. reserve_seats validates positive qty/nonempty keys, enforces capacity, atomically inserts and decrements, and replays identical keys only. expire_holds releases held rows at expires_at <= now once. Holds last 600 seconds.
constraints: Use the C++17 standard library and supplied read-only helpers only.
Do not change read-only files or tests.
